verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents self-serve, pay-as-you-go pricing for all APIs with no subscription required, and a public pricing page covering search context size, Pro Search, Agent API tools and flex (0.5×) / priority (2×) service-tier multipliers. It also says every response includes exact token counts and published costs per request, and usage tiers advance automatically with credit spend rather than through sales. The HN commenter notes the pricing 'looks the same as always', which suggests it is publicly visible. missing for 10: the actual per-token or per-request dollar rates are not quoted in the evidence, and there is no independent hands-on confirmation of per-request cost clarity.
